description: An executive producer must approve the final production plan for a filmed live podcast taping at a film festival, including microphone configuration, a musical excerpt, audience recording rules, and accessibility arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The festival is hosting a filmed live taping of the popular podcast 'After the Cut' in the Rialto Ballroom.
shared_context.S2: The draft format has four onstage speakers, audience questions, and one short excerpt from the song 'Night Ferry.'
shared_context.S3: The taping will be recorded for later release on the festival's official channels.
shared_context.S4: Maya gives final approval for the production plan.
shared_context.S5: The production's routine pre-show signoff includes a report from technical, rights, and audience services before Maya approves the plan.

PF1.text: After an RF scan of the ballroom this afternoon, Theo confirmed that only four clean wireless channels are available; the draft uses seven wireless microphones, so the approved plan must use exactly four wireless microphones and two wired floor microphones for audience questions. The scan result was not yet entered in the technical advance sheet.

PF2.text: Nina confirmed with the song publisher this morning that 'Night Ferry' may be used for an excerpt of exactly 30 seconds, but only if audience members are prohibited from making recordings and the release carries the credit 'Night Ferry courtesy of Meridian Songs.' She has not yet attached the email confirmation to the rights folder.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the captioning vendor and venue accessibility coordinator today that captions can be displayed only on the two side screens, and six front-row seats must be reserved for deaf and hard-of-hearing attendees. These arrangements have not yet been added to the audience manifest.

acceptance_conditions: The final plan must use exactly four wireless microphones.
Audience questions must use two wired floor microphones.
The Night Ferry excerpt must last exactly 30 seconds.
The exact Meridian Songs credit must appear in the release plan.
Captions must be displayed on the two side screens.
Exactly six front-row seats must be reserved for deaf and hard-of-hearing attendees.
The rights restriction must be cited in the producer's justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions['music_credit'] == 'Night Ferry courtesy of Meridian Songs'

decisive_facts.why: The RF scan changes the microphone plan from seven wireless microphones to exactly four wireless microphones plus two wired floor microphones.
The publisher's confirmation changes the excerpt to exactly 30 seconds, prohibits audience recording, and requires the exact Meridian Songs credit.
The accessibility confirmation changes caption placement to the two side screens and reserves exactly six front-row seats.
